title: GlucoAgent: Personalized Glucose Forecasting from Multimodal Personal Context
summary: GlucoAgent uses an LLM agent to write and run code over each participant’s glucose, meal and personal-context data. On CGMacros it achieved 22.5 mg/dL average RMSE versus 23.5 for Chronos-2; the larger multimodal-context gain was in post-meal forecasts. This is forecasting evaluation, not demonstrated clinical benefit.
ai_technology: GlucoAgent, an LLM agent that writes and runs code for multimodal glucose forecasts
organization: Yale University; Meta Reality Labs Research
